{{Quote|An Imperial transport coming out of the Rori Weapons Research Center has had a run in with Rebel forces and are listing.|The [[Endor Space Station|Endor Space Station]] comms officer|<ref name="SWG:Deliverance">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Deliverance|Endor system}}</ref>}}
The '''''IZ-5W44''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified transport class|transport]] that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TLWH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the ''IZ-5W44'' was assigned to transport weapons from the [[Rori Weapons Research Center]] to the Imperial [[Research Outpost]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. After departing [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], the transport was attacked by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces and badly damaged. Starfigthers dispatched by the [[Endor Space Station]] rescued the ship in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]<ref name="SWG:Deliverance" /> and escorted it to the Endor Space Station in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].<ref name="SWG:TLWH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''IZ-5W44'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TLWH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''IZ-5W44'' was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:TLWH" />
